newsitem.title: USA: Missouri Gov. expects to act on fiscal 1998 budget.
newsitem.headline: Missouri Gov. expects to act on fiscal 1998 budget.

text.p: Missouri Gov. Mel Carnahan is scheduled to act Thursday on the proposed $14.7 billion all funds budget for fiscal 1998, spokesman Chris Sifford said.
Along with their $6.4 billion operating budget approved in May, lawmakers adopted a compromise health package eliminating Planned Parenthood funding from the budget.

That decision broke a legislative stalemate, but placed them squarely opposite Carnahan, who has line-item veto powers. The governor also noted at the time that a court ruling had barred earlier attempts by legislators to accomplish the same goal.
The budget sent to Carnahan includes $5.9 million for family planning and increased wages and benefits for state employees, lawmakers and judges.
